def factor_drawdown_recovery_volregime(df):
    """Drawdown recovery ratio scaled by volume regime conviction."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    # Core mechanism: drawdown recovery ratio
    rolling_max_60 = close.rolling(60, min_periods=1).max()
    drawdown = close / rolling_max_60 - 1
    rolling_min_5 = close.rolling(5, min_periods=1).min()
    recovery = close / rolling_min_5 - 1
    denominator = -drawdown
    denominator_safe = denominator.replace(0, np.nan)
    recovery_ratio = recovery / denominator_safe
    recovery_ratio = recovery_ratio.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0)
    # Lightweight modifier: volume regime conviction
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, _ = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(volume, window=20)
    weight = 1.0 + 0.2 * is_high_vol - 0.3 * is_low_vol
    factor = recovery_ratio * weight
    df_copy["factor_drawdown_recovery_volregime"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_drawdown_recovery_volregime"]
description: This factor measures the ratio of short-term bounce to drawdown depth, scaled by volume regime conviction. The core mechanism captures resilience after a drawdown. Bounces during low-volume periods may be noisy or manipulative, while high-volume bounces signal stronger conviction. The volume regime weight enhances the signal during high-volume regimes and dampens it during low-volume regimes, improving the economic quality of the bounce signal without altering the core ratio.
